title: go42x journal entry
description: Record of one task in <journal directory>/<id>/entry.json, written by go42x agentenv journal.

$schema.description: Link to this schema at the go42x revision that last wrote the entry

id.description: Creation date, title slug, and random suffix; equals the entry directory name

tags.description: One type of work and the affected areas

keep.description: true keeps the entry; otherwise journal gc deletes it once it goes without an update for the configured retention

runtime.description: Runtime that last wrote the entry, such as claude, codex, or human; log.jsonl keeps every writer

session.description: Session identifier reported by the runtime that last wrote the entry

refs.description: Work the entry belongs to, recorded at the last write
